matches.rationale: GT1 concerns conflicting definitions of network depth (residual blocks vs. Dense layers) and how depth is reported in experiments. Pred_id 1 addresses parameter scaling relationships between width and depth, which is a completely different methodological issue. Different locus and different defect per R1 and R4.

GT2 concerns an inconsistency in the critic's scoring function (L2 norm vs. dot product). Pred_id 1 addresses parameter count scaling with width vs. depth. These are entirely different defects in different parts of the method, failing R1.
